name: 白背心数字人（OM 版）
look: 年轻东亚女性，黑色长发带脸侧碎发，白色罗纹背心，竖屏自拍构图，室内自然光

avatar.method: openai_image（gpt-image-2）生成固定形象图，存 assets/avatar_ref.jpg；换形象时重新生成并覆盖
avatar.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a young East Asian woman in her mid-20s, long black hair with face-framing strands, wearing a white ribbed tank top, vertical 9:16 selfie-style framing, chest-up, facing the camera with a closed mouth and warm friendly expression, even soft indoor natural light, plain clean background, no text, no watermark.

voice.desc: young friendly female voice, clear and patient but lively, natural pace
voice.fallback_tts: dashscope_tts（qwen3-tts-flash，voice=Cherry 中文标准 / Dylan 北京话 / Kiki 粤语 / Jada 上海话 / Eric 四川话 / Jennifer 英语女声），仅用于旁白片或补丁句

720p.note: 720p fast 按 $0.13/s 报价；mini 720p 每秒价格以网关实时返回为准

acts.full: warm eye contact, expressive face, natural hand gestures
acts.pip: calm explaining tone, small nods, occasionally glancing down as if reading a screen, small pointing gestures
acts.vlog: relaxed lifestyle vlogger sharing a favorite tool, natural small head tilts and nods, one hand comes up briefly in a casual gesture
acts.depth: medium shot with generous headroom and plain background visible on both sides of the head and shoulders (for text-behind-subject graphics), calm confident delivery

prompt_template: A {age} {sex} presenter in {scene}, framed tight chest-up so hands stay out of frame, facing the camera. She is a friendly Chinese tech vlogger {purpose}: {act}. She speaks Mandarin Chinese in a {voice}. The presenter says: "{line}" — mouth movements precisely lip-synced to this exact Chinese line, natural pronunciation, no other speech. Sound: only her voice and quiet room tone, no music, no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text of any kind.
segment_rule: 每段一句或两句，≤12 秒（约 5.4 字/秒，段长 = ceil(字数/5.4 + 1.0)，夹在 4–12 秒）；超过 12 秒先拆段
disclosure: 内容由 AI 数字人演绎
languages_tested_note: 台词直接写目标语言并指定 she speaks {language}；回听用 whisper 按语言转写
